# SysInfo

> One-line system info & hardware brand/model collector with VPS oversell detection and CPU/disk benchmarks for Linux and macOS. 單一 Bash 腳本：系統資訊、硬體品牌型號查詢、VPS 超開檢測與基準測試。

## Install
- [curl one-liner](https://sys.nev3rw1n.com/): `curl -fsSL https://sys.nev3rw1n.com/ | bash`
- [wget one-liner](https://sys.nev3rw1n.com/): `wget -qO- https://sys.nev3rw1n.com/ | bash`

## Features
- System information: OS, kernel, architecture, uptime, load, virtualization
- CPU info: model, physical/logical cores, cache sizes, frequency, key ISA flags (avx2, avx512, aes, vmx, svm)
- Memory: total, used, available, swap
- RAM modules: per-slot capacity, type, speed, manufacturer, part number
- Disk: partitions, SSD/HDD type, model
- Hardware devices: network interfaces (IP/MAC), GPU, machine info
- Brand & Model: CPU vendor/model/version/microcode, GPU model, motherboard manufacturer/model/version, BIOS vendor/version/date, RAM speed
- Oversell detection: CPU cache size, vCPU steal time, memory vs physical RAM, vCPU count checks
- Benchmarks: CPU (sysbench/openssl) and disk I/O (1G direct)

## Platforms
- Linux: /proc/cpuinfo, lscpu, free, dmidecode (root recommended for brand/model and RAM modules)
- macOS: system_profiler, sysctl, vm_stat
